It carries the list from 44:25 into {{ar:زُرُوعٍۢ}} ({{tr:zurūʿin}}), so crops enter under the same abandoned-inventory frame instead of starting independent predication. Because the particle is prefixed to the crop noun, the new asset arrives already joined to the list in writing, recitation, and syntax. words.prose: {{ar:زُرُوعٍۢ}} ({{tr:zurūʿin}}) names cultivated production, not decorative vegetation. Its genitive case has to be recovered from the carried partitive inventory frame in 44:25, so the crop word is grammatically fed by the previous ayah just as its image is fed by the earlier gardens and springs. The indefinite broken plural makes the loss broad: not one marked field, but open-ended crop holdings and repeated plantings. The root pressure of sowing, growth, and organized farming lets the noun compress land, labor, water, waiting, and yield into one abandoned asset. Read beside {{ar:مَقَامٍۢ}} ({{tr:maqāmin}}), the word also sets up the ayah's movement from productive infrastructure to established status. Its recurrence field sharpens that point: the sowing question at 56:63-64 asks who truly produces growth, while here the produced crops are left outside imperial control; another abundance inventory at 26:148 lets the same crop field be heard as prosperity turned into loss. Its long ū makes the first content word linger in a relatively marked agricultural slot before the station phrase answers it. The variant that substitutes enjoyment and permanence keeps the slot's pressure on possessed abundance, but the local reading selects agricultural property.

words.prose: {{ar:مَقَامٍۢ}} ({{tr:maqāmin}}) turns the inventory from yield to establishment. Like the crop noun, it is genitive because the partitive frame from 44:25 still governs it, and its indefiniteness makes status itself a listable possession rather than a secure named seat. The q-w-m field gives the word a concrete standing-place image while the local noun narrows that range to station, residence, rank, and established position. Within Surah 44, that same root thread shifts from people-language toward place and rank, so standing is tested across domains. The following {{ar:كَرِيمٍۢ}} ({{tr:karīmin}}) is locked to this noun, so honor belongs first to the station phrase, not to the whole inventory. The maqam-muqam variant contrast usefully tilts the slot toward inhabited residence, but the local surface keeps station and standing-place in view. The exact phrase recurs at 26:58, making the honored station a recognizable formula of abandoned prestige; the following inheritance movement at 44:28 then makes this apparently stable station look transferable. As a relatively rare station form within a common q-w-m root family, it also matches the surrounding indefinite tanwīn cadence rather than sounding like a generic status word.

words.prose: {{ar:كَرِيمٍۢ}} ({{tr:karīmin}}) closes the ayah by naming value. Its singular masculine genitive agreement locks it to {{ar:مَقَامٍۢ}} ({{tr:maqāmin}}), so the honor does not spread back to the plural crops; it seals the station phrase. The k-r-m range includes generosity and honoring, but the local adjective selects noble, precious, high-value dignity for a place or standing, not a generous person. That makes the loss qualitative as well as spatial: what is left is not just a residence or office, but a dignified privilege. The adjective also carries echoes. Within the surah, honor-language moves from the noble messenger at 44:17 to {{ar:مَقَامٍۢ كَرِيمٍۢ}} ({{tr:maqāmin karīmin}}) here, and the exact phrase recurs at 26:58 as part of an abandoned-prestige inventory. Human honoring at 17:70 sharpens the contrast: here honor marks a place whose prestige cannot secure its holders. Finally, the postposed adjective lets the reader register station first and then receive its value as the closing seal; its final tanwīn completes the chain with {{ar:زُرُوعٍۢ}} ({{tr:zurūʿin}}) and {{ar:مَقَامٍۢ}} ({{tr:maqāmin}}), binding productivity, station, and honor as equally listable.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated sequence joins crops, a maqam, and karim without an expressed break between their domains.
baseline_models.mechanism: Cultivation supplies recurring yield, the maqam supplies a site of settled occupancy, and karim supplies intrinsic excellence and generous social display. Together they form a productive, inhabitable estate rather than three unrelated luxuries.

activation_trace.role: The crop-growing branch grounds recurring cultivation and yield as the estate's productive layer.
The station-and-residence branch makes maqam the settled spatial center of the cultivated holding.
The noble-generous branch makes the residence both excellent in itself and a site of prestigious hospitality.

changed_reading.before: A short inventory of crops plus a fine residence.
changed_reading.after: A linked cultivated estate in which yield, settled occupancy, and prestigious hospitality sustain one another.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Zurua, maqam, and karim can all participate in one material ecology of growth and support.
baseline_models.mechanism: The crops are living output, maqam activates qiwam as the support and livelihood by which life remains standing, and karim activates fertile soil and rain-bearing bounty. The phrase can therefore name a self-maintaining agrarian system, not merely its visible products.

activation_trace.role: The cultivation branch supplies the system's growing output and its dependence on continued tending.
The support-and-subsistence branch turns maqam into the material qiwam that keeps the whole estate functioning.
The fertile-growth and rain branch lets karim qualify the productive ecology rather than only its social rank.

changed_reading.before: Crops stand beside an elegant place.
changed_reading.after: Growth, livelihood-support, fertile ground, and rain compose a single sustaining habitat.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same three words can be read through cultivation contracts, management, valuation, and competitive prestige.
baseline_models.mechanism: Agricultural dealing organizes production, qiyam supplies governance and valuation, and karam supplies rivalry in honor. The maqam is then an institution or seat whose nobility is socially produced and displayed through control of productive land.

activation_trace.role: The sharecropping branch introduces an organized agricultural relation rather than crops as inert scenery.
The guardianship-and-governance branch makes the maqam a managed seat that stands over productive affairs.
The valuation branch supplies the estate's economic appraisal and exchangeable worth.
The rivalry-in-generosity branch makes karim a competitive prestige claim attached to the seat.

changed_reading.after: A managed productive institution whose apparent nobility is made legible through value, control, and prestige competition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The demand to render servants and the ban on exalting oneself expose a labor-and-power underside to the cultivated maqam. The focus branches for agricultural dealing, subsistence, and prestige now permit the estate to be read as a regime whose elevated display may depend on controlled people.

activation_trace.role: The agricultural-dealing branch supplies the productive relation into which coerced labor can be abductively inserted.
The livelihood-and-mainstay branch makes human labor a possible support beneath the maqam's visible stability.
The competitive-prestige branch permits noble display to be treated as a social claim rather than an innocent surface quality.
The rendering-of-a-right branch casts release of the servants as an obligation owed, exposing a contested relation of possession.
The servitude-and-ownership branch supplies the concrete dominated human relation beneath the elite estate.
The tyrannical-exaltation branch identifies the vertical power posture that converts material abundance into domination.

structural_cues: 44:18 demands the transfer of God's servants immediately after the noble messenger enters the Pharaoh sequence.
44:19 forbids self-exaltation before 44:25-27 inventory the abandoned productive luxury.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: owed delivery, servitude, and tyrannical elevation surround the estate list. Reader arrow: controlled labor supports the crops and elite maqam. Live alternative: the people and property may be narratively adjacent without an asserted production relation.

changed_reading.before: A prestigious agrarian residence owned by powerful people.
changed_reading.after: A possible coercive production system in which captive service is the hidden qiwam of the supposedly noble station.

context_deltas.mechanism: Leaving preserves an estate as residue; inheritance transfers it; another qawm stands in the former occupants' place. Maqam consequently behaves as a persistent institutional and material slot whose holders can be replaced while crops and structures remain.

activation_trace.role: The cultivated-crop branch supplies productive assets capable of outlasting their cultivators.
The residence-and-station branch grounds the enduring place from which one group departs and another benefits.
The branch of a trace remaining after departure makes the listed estate a residue rather than annihilated scenery.
The inheritance-transfer branch supplies movement of the whole holding from predecessors to successors.
The substitution branch lets another people occupy the role and place vacated by the first group.

structural_cues: The repeated leave construction flows directly into the focus inventory.
44:28 immediately assigns the inherited estate to another people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: departure leaves a trace, inheritance moves assets, and a new group follows. Reader arrow: maqam is a transferable slot as well as a building. Live alternative: inheritance may concern the surrounding property without making maqam institutional.

changed_reading.before: A residence securely identified with its owners.
changed_reading.after: A durable estate-office that survives its occupants and exposes their replaceability.

context_deltas.mechanism: Karim moves from the rejected messenger, to the abandoned maqam, to a condemned addressee under the imperative to taste. That trajectory makes nobility a contested predicate: true in one bearer, materially displayed in another setting, and exposed as boast or irony in a third.

activation_trace.role: The praiseworthy-nobility branch first attaches genuine honor to the messenger whom the regime rejects.
The same noble-generous branch transfers the question of authentic honor from a person to the abandoned station.
The overpowering-might branch supplies the status formula paired with karim at the moment of punitive reversal.
The outdoing-and-prestige branch activates the possibility that karim here voices a boast now turned against its claimant.
The experiential-tasting branch converts an honor title into a verdict tested by suffered reality.

structural_cues: The exact adjective karim occurs on the messenger at 44:17, the maqam at 44:26, and the punished addressee at 44:49.
The 44:49 command to taste makes the last title answerable to experience rather than self-description.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: one adjective crosses messenger, place, and punished claimant, with experiential tasting at the last use. Reader arrow: the sequence audits competing claims to honor. Live alternative: each occurrence may simply bear its local ordinary sense without a cross-ayah transfer.

changed_reading.before: Karim straightforwardly endorses the station's splendor.
changed_reading.after: Karim marks a contested economy of honor: the regime recognizes noble property while rejecting a noble messenger, and its prestige can later be voiced as condemning irony.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later maqam amin repeats the station construction and then restores gardens and springs. Protection and heart-settling security supply what maqam karim conspicuously does not name, producing a counter-estate whose occupants and abundance are no longer transferable through catastrophe.

activation_trace.role: The station-and-residence branch anchors the first maqam as the spatial term repeated in the later counter-scene.
The dear-and-valued branch makes karim specify preciousness, which can be contrasted with actual safety.
The protective warding branch supplies the condition that secures the later station against the earlier estate's reversal.
The repeated residence branch creates a direct spatial mirror of the focus maqam.
The heart-settling security branch changes the station's decisive quality from admired value to durable safety.
The tree-screened garden branch restores the estate setting around the secure maqam.
The flowing-spring branch repeats the water source paired with the abandoned gardens before the focus.

structural_cues: 44:51 repeats maqam with amin where 44:26 has karim.
44:52 repeats the gardens-and-springs pair from 44:25 immediately after the new maqam.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: the same station noun and garden-spring frame return under protection and security. Reader arrow: qualifier replacement contrasts admired but losable prestige with safeguarded dwelling. Live alternative: the later scene may intensify rather than negate the earlier estate model.

changed_reading.before: Maqam karim is the peak form of desirable residence.
changed_reading.after: It is an intentionally incomplete prototype: precious and impressive, but answered by a protected maqam whose defining good is security.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus estate produces crops through cultivation; the later secure inhabitants call for every fruit, and the whole provision is named as gift and benefaction from the Lord. Abundance shifts from managed production and possession to responsive provision received without anxiety.

activation_trace.role: The sowing-and-growing branch makes the focus abundance labor-, season-, and maintenance-dependent.
The fertile-land and rain branch supplies the contingent environmental bounty of the first estate.
The calling branch makes desired provision responsive to request rather than tied to field labor.
The pleasant-fruit branch converts agricultural output into immediately enjoyed provision.
The security branch removes the fear of loss that shadows ownership of the focus estate.
The benefaction-and-gift branch recodes abundance as received favor rather than accumulated estate capital.
The nurturing-and-completing branch assigns ongoing provision to a sustaining giver rather than to the station's owners.

structural_cues: 44:55 joins every fruit, calling, and safety in one provision scene.
44:57 explicitly locates that scene under favor from the Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: cultivated crops precede fruit on call, security, and gifted favor. Reader arrow: these are contrasting modes of abundance, produced possession versus received provision. Live alternative: the later fruit may simply perfect the same cultivation model rather than replace it.

changed_reading.before: The crops are the durable source of the estate's abundance.
changed_reading.after: They mark contingent, owner-managed abundance that the later gift economy transforms into secure provision available on call.

context_deltas.mechanism: Resurrection, judicial separation, and an appointed time activate qiyam and harvest branches inside the focus. The estate becomes a seasonal tenure: crops mature, occupancy pauses, and its holders move toward a fixed standing at which possession and persons are separated.

activation_trace.role: The harvesting branch turns the crops from static assets into yield approaching an endpoint.
The resurrection-and-standing branch lets maqam anticipate a later standing rather than promise permanent occupancy.
The revival-after-death branch supplies the very rising denied by the speakers and activates the focus qiyam branch.
The judicial-separation branch gives the later standing a discriminating function that ends undifferentiated possession.
The fixed-appointment branch imposes a terminus on residence and on the estate's apparent continuity.

structural_cues: 44:35 voices denial of being raised, while 44:40 names a day of separation as the common appointment.
The focus's crops and maqam naturally admit seasonal and temporal dimensions even before the context activates them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: resurrection, discriminating judgment, and fixed appointment follow the abandoned estate. Reader arrow: crop harvest and qiyam make ownership a bounded tenure ending in another standing. The rain-bearing bounty branch makes atmospheric fertility a latent component of the station's karim quality.
The earth-revived-by-rain branch supplies the life-giving version of the vertical exchange.
The overhead-sky branch identifies the same upper domain as the source channel for the coming reversal.
The rising-smoke branch replaces rain-bearing descent with obscuring atmospheric output.
The all-enveloping cover branch completes the reversal by making atmosphere smother rather than nourish inhabitants.

changed_reading.after: Cultivation is morally polarized: what people grow or prize can return as food that acts inside them, while another context offers fruit in safety.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Surprising because it activates the remote q-w-m image of an intact blind eye and lets nearby springs and denied weeping echo it; valid because maqam is the focus anchor and abandonment supplies loss of function without loss of form. Render only as a material analogy, never as a translation of maqam or ayun.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Maqam can activate the branch of an eye that remains physically standing after sight has gone.

activation_trace.role: The intact-but-blind standing-eye branch supplies a body-like model of preserved structure with vanished function.
The remaining-trace branch makes the estate persist materially after its users disappear.
The flowing-spring branch supplies the literal eyes of water beside the station and keeps the eye analogy materially tethered.
The grief-and-tears branch, explicitly negated for sky and earth, sharpens the image of a landscape present but no longer responsive to its occupants.

changed_reading.before: The former estate is merely vacant.
changed_reading.after: It can be pictured as an intact standing shell whose social sight and living function have gone out.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Surprising because it combines remote branches for sharecropping, a brisk market, and a return-seeking gift; valid because all three attach to the focus roots and inheritance without bargain supplies the reversal. Render as an economic-institution hypothesis, not as lexical glosses of zurua, maqam, or karim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus roots admit agricultural contracting, market activity, valuation, and prestige exchange within one estate.

activation_trace.role: The sharecropping branch supplies contracted agricultural production as one layer of the maqam's economy.
The brisk-market branch lets the station function as an exchange hub rather than only a residence.
The gift-for-recompense branch supplies prestige exchange in which generosity anticipates return.
The transfer-without-contract branch abruptly overturns the estate's inferred bargaining and recompense economy.

changed_reading.before: The station is valuable property within an ordinary economy.
changed_reading.after: It is a contract-and-prestige marketplace whose entire exchange logic is canceled when the holding passes to successors without bargain or cost.

strongest_changes: The servant-transfer and anti-exaltation sequence makes the estate legible as a possible coercive production system.
Leaving, inheritance, and substitution turn maqam into a persistent slot whose occupants are replaceable.
Karim's movement from messenger to estate to punished claimant destabilizes prestige and tests competing kinds of honor.
The later maqam amin with repeated gardens and springs answers admired residence with protected residence.
Fixed judgment, atmospheric smoke, and the punitive food chain keep temporal, ecological, and embodied readings alive beside the social reading.
summary.what_was_special: The three-word focus behaved less like a luxury list than a switchyard: context separately activated its agrarian ecology, labor regime, transferable office, unstable honor title, bounded tenure, vulnerable atmosphere, and opposed modes of provision without forcing those mechanisms into one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The coerced-labor relation is abductively coherent but not explicitly stated as the cause of the crops.
Karim may remain narrator-endorsed excellence at 44:26 even while later context exposes false human claims to the same word.
The 44:51-52 mirror may contrast, replace, or simply intensify the earlier estate pattern.
Harvest, atmospheric, blind-eye, market, and vine activations are mechanism-bearing branch analogies, not lexical translations.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **A noble station is exposed as agriculturally sustained, not self-grounding.** `ز ر ع B001` supplies cultivation, `ق و م B006` station/residence, and `ك ر م B001/B002` nobility and growth-bearing bounty. The list joins crops to prestigious residence; I infer that status depends materially on cultivated provision. The ayah reads the “noble station” as a supported ecology whose occupants could not secure it.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 44:51 repeats `مقام` but qualifies it as secure, and 44:57 attributes that station's outcome to lordly bounty. The later contrast shows that nobility without security and acknowledged source is a fragile social rating.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The list is a complete subsistence system.** `ز ر ع` `B001` is cultivation and crop growth; `ق و م` `B006` is station or residence and `B009` the support by which something stands; `ك ر م` `B002` is fertile, rain-bearing bounty. Together with gardens and springs (`44:25`) and ease (`44:27`), the nouns form production, water, settlement, and enjoyment. The packet supplies the components; I infer **resource integration -> durable social standing**. The ayah reads as infrastructure, not a decorative inventory.

2. **The noble station is valuable because it sustains.** `ك ر م` `B010` is a dear or highly valued thing and `B001` praiseworthy excellence; `ق و م` `B004` adds care and preservation. Since the entire system is left and then assigned to others (`44:28`), honor here attaches to the station’s life-supporting function rather than its owners’ rank. The packet supplies utility and transfer; I infer **sustaining capacity -> value independent of holder**. `مَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ` becomes an excellent emplacement that survives political possession.

3. **Cultivation contains the possibility of reversal.** `ز ر ع` `B006` is harvesting the crop as well as `B001` growing it. The people are called criminals through `ج ر م`’s cutting/harvesting branch (`44:22`), then their cultivation is itself “harvested” into another people’s possession (`44:28`). The packet supplies the lexical material analogy; I infer **coercive cutting-off -> one’s own productive order becoming harvestable**. Exploratorily, `زُرُوعٍ` carries both accumulated growth and its susceptibility to removal.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: `مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍ` in `44:51` supplies a later station whose defining excellence is security, and `44:57` identifies its abundance as lordly bounty. The contrast sharpened `مَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ` here: a valuable productive emplacement can survive its holders, whereas secure standing depends on a durable protective relation.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, dalı hem kişide veya şeyde bulunan övgüye değer üstünlük hem de eli açıklık, bağışlayıcılık, ayıptan uzak durma ve başkasını onurlandırma alanı olarak kurar. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu geniş çekirdeği doğru biçimde karşılar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, kolye, üzüm, kap kapağı ve kalça kemiği gibi aynı kökten gelen bağımsız nesne adlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, genel nitelik çekirdeğini ayrı tutar; belirli söz kalıpları, eylemler ve özel kullanımlar bu çekirdeğin bağımlı gerçekleşmeleri olarak gösterilir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişide, davranışta ya da şeyde kendi alanına göre bulunan övgüye değer üstünlük; insanda eli açıklık, bağışlayıcılık ve utanç verici olandan uzak durma biçiminde belirir. Başkasını onurlandırma ve ona küçültücü olmayan değerli bir yarar ulaştırma da bu anlam alanına girer.

facets.statement: Kişi, davranış veya şey kendi alanında üstün ve övgüye değer sayılır.
İnsandaki çekirdek görünüm eli açıklık, bol iyilik, bağışlayıcılık ve güzel huydur.
Başkasını onurlandırmak veya ona incitmeden değerli bir yarar sağlamak bu niteliğin eylemsel uzantısıdır.
Kişinin kendisini ayıp ve utanç verici işlerden uzak tutması, kendi değerini koruyan bir tutum olarak anlatılır.
Övgüye değer çocuklar dünyaya getirmek veya değerli bir bağ ya da varlık edinmek bu geniş niteliğin özel örnekleridir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, övgüye değer üstünlük ile eli açıklık ve güzel huy çekirdeğinde birleşir; bağışlama, ayıptan kaçınma ve başkasını onurlandırma bu çekirdeğin başlıca görünümleridir. Övgüye değer çocuklar sahibi olmak ile değerli bir bağ ya da varlık edinmek de kaynakta verilen özel örneklerdir.

Aynı işlev, karşıdakinin kendisi veya gözü için değer bildiren çeşitli kalıp biçimlerle söylenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bu sözleri olumlu kabulü sevgi ve değer verme duygusuyla güçlendiren yanıtlar olarak birleştirir; birden çok kalıp biçim aynı işlevi taşır.

error_profile.preserves: Kabulü, gönüllülüğü ve karşıdaki kişiye değer verme yönünü korur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu yalın bir doğrulamadır; odak dal kabulü duygusal sıcaklık ve karşıdakini onurlandırma anlamıyla genişletir.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, kabul dışında doğrudan övgü ve bir işi yapmaya duyulan en güçlü isteği bildiren kalıpları da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: övgü, sıcak kabul ve güçlü istek kalıbı
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal, sıcak kabul ve sevgi bildiren bazı kalıp sözlerde doğrudan kesişir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir yanda kişiye çok değerli gelen herhangi bir kişi veya şeyi, öte yanda bir topluluğun soylu ve seçkin temsilcisini anlatır. Verilen değerli kişi çerçevesi kullanılabilir, ancak nesneleri de kapsayan ilk kullanımla topluluğun seçkin kişisini anlatan ikinci kullanımın ayrılması gerekir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca insanı anlatmaz; değer verilen bir şey de kapsama girebilir, topluluk kullanımı ise özellikle soylu ve seçkin kişiye bağlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, kişiye değerli gelen kişi veya şey kullanımını topluluğun seçkin kişisi yapısından ayırır ve bu yapılardan bağımsız yalın bir anlam varsaymaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin gözünde çok değerli olan herhangi bir kişi veya şey ya da bir topluluğun soylu, saygın ve seçkin temsilcisidir.

facets.statement: Bir kişi veya şey, sahibi ya da ilgilisi için vazgeçilmesi zor derecede değerli olabilir.
Değer verilen kimse uğruna, kişinin değerli bulduğu başka şeyleri esirgememesi beklenebilir.
Topluluk yapısında söz, o topluluğun soylu, saygın ve seçkin kişisini belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Bu dal için ortaklaştırılacak çok kaynaklı bir açıklama yoktur; değer verilen varlık ve topluluğun seçkin kişisi kullanımları tek sözlükte tanıklanır.

source_details.summary: Kişiye çok değerli gelen kişi veya şey ile bir topluluğun soylu ve seçkin temsilcisi iki bağlı kullanım olarak verilir.

concept_gloss.text: değer verilen varlık ve topluluğun seçkin kişisi
concept_gloss.applicability: Kişisel olarak değer verilen kişi veya şeyi ve topluluk içindeki soylu temsilciyi birlikte açıklayan üst karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişi ya da şey kapsamını, yüksek değeri ve topluluk içindeki seçkinlik kullanımını korur.

error_profile.preserves: Değer veren kişiyi ve değer verilen kişi ya da şey kapsamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir topluluğu temsil eden, soyu ve saygınlığıyla öne çıkan kişi bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Topluluk bağını, soyluluğu ve seçkinliği korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, sahibine değerli gelen tekil kişi ya da şeyi ve topluluğun soylu temsilcisini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, bir topluluk veya nesne grubunun seçkinleri, önde gelenleri ve geride kalan seçilmiş bölümü gibi çoğul kümeleri de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal topluluk içinden seçkin ve üstün sayılan kişi alanında kesişir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu, seçkinlerden oluşan grup veya seçilmiş bölüm kavramına uzanır; odak dal kişisel değer ilişkisine ve tek bir soylu temsilciye bağlıdır.
